shellCommands.command: git status --short && echo "---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | sort && echo "---" && cat package.json && echo "---" && git diff package.json

for f in components/AppProvider.js pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js "pages/api/posts/[id].js" pages/api/posts/index.js "pages/blog/[id].js" pages/blog/index.js pages/index.js styles/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done

ls node_modules/.package-lock.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules present" || echo "no node_modules"; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/font/google 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls public 2>/dev/null
rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && git status --short && echo "--- tsc ---" && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail -20
git status --short; echo "---"; git diff tsconfig.json; cat .gitignore

rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git checkout tsconfig.json && printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
.next/
*.tsbuildinfo
' > .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "tsc exit: $?"

printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
' > .gitignore && git status --short && echo "---" && find app components types -type f | sort
